programme.title: Fristet
programme.desc: Denne uge har på mange måder stået i venskabernes tegn. Gamle venner er vendt tilbage til villaen. Nye har plantet knive i hinandens rygge. Og i dag er ikke anderledes.

programme.title: Fristet
programme.desc: Der er skidt stemning på rødt hold. Gruppens stærke dame er nedtrykt og bitter, efter de andre forsøgte sig med en kniv i ryggen på hende i sidste uge.

programme.title: Fristet
programme.desc: Det er en flok tømmermandsramte deltagere, der vågner op til nøglekort på bordet. Rødt holds stærke dame, som stadig ikke helt er kommet sig over holdkammeraternes kniv i ryggen, ryger i Fristelsernes Kammer.

programme.title: Fristet
programme.desc: Der er fortsat ballade mellem to af villaens par, og for det ene af parrene synes skårene at være for store at klinke, så de ender med at gøre det forbi.

programme.title: Fristet
programme.desc: De to udsatte går den tunge gang til Fristelsernes Kammer, hvor Adam venter. Og for begge skal udfordringerne vise sig at være pinsler, de har mere end svært ved at overskue at skulle udsætte sig selv for.

programme.title: Fristet
programme.desc: Deltagerne vågner op til en uge, hvor finalen i den grad føles nær. Og intet er, som det plejer i den smukke middelhavsvilla.

programme.title: Fristet
programme.desc: Som så ofte før begynder dagen med nøglekort til to af villaens beboere – men i dag kommer turen i Fristelsernes Kammer til at forløbe sig noget anderledes, end den plejer.

programme.title: Fristet
programme.desc: Fra begyndelsen af dagen er der kold luft mellem de to tidligere venner, der nu er røget uklar på grund af den sidstankomne deltager, der er vendt tilbage til villaen med masser af ballade i kufferten.

programme.title: Fristet
programme.desc: Der er en presset stemning lige fra morgenstunden. Alle deltagerne er på dupperne, for i aften bliver afgørende for det ene af holdene.

programme.title: Fristet
programme.desc: Der er kun få deltagere tilbage i Adams villa, som kæmper om den store pengepræmie på 350.000 kr.

programme.title: Fristet
programme.desc: Lige fra morgenstunden er der atter action i villaen. Deltagerne får til opgave at give hinanden titler, og det får konsekvenser for to af dem.

programme.title: Fristet
programme.desc: Deltagerne når knapt at tørre søvnen ud af øjnene, før de får øje på panikknappen. Men modsat de forrige onsdage, er der denne finaleonsdag ingen hjælp at hente fra Adam.

programme.title: Fristet
programme.desc: Det er nogle forvirrede finalister, der vågner op til den store finaledag. Gårsdagens Retssal spøger stadig, og det valg, de skal træffe, bliver langt fra så let, som der kunne have været.

programme.title: Fristet
programme.desc: 10 superspændte deltagere ankommer til fristelsernes villa i Tyrkiet uvidende om, at de næste 12 uger vil blive mødt med dilemmaer og udfordringer, der vil presse dem hårdt på etik, moral og ikke mindst deres følelser.

programme.title: Fristet
programme.desc: Allerede fra morgenstunden får de 11 deltagere besøg af Adam Duvå Hall. Den nye pige, Maria, skal nemlig afsløre, hvilket hold hun vil på.

programme.title: Fristet

programme.title: Fristet

programme.title: Fristet
programme.desc: På det røde hold har deltagerne travlt med at få vasket tavlen ren efter sidste uges interne stridigheder. Men alt er endnu ikke fred og idyl, og der er fortsat hvisken i krogene på rød stue.

programme.title: Fristet
programme.desc: Der er dagen-derpå stemning i villaen, og beboerne sladrer om gårsdagens fest. Særligt Kasper og Irinas romantiske alliance er i fokus.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Has Gary Met His Match?

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Couples Counselling
programme.desc: Da slænget gør sig klar til at forlade huset, må Marnie tage en beslutning om Aaron. Gary og Abbie er glade for deres åbne forhold, men da Marnie taler med Aaron, ser det ud til, at Maaron er slut for altid.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Parsnip Party

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Chloe Confronts Abbie

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Chloe's First Date
programme.desc: Geordierne er tilbage efter at have festet vildt i Tenerife, og det er ikke kun vejret, der bliver hedt! Steph vil score, og efter at være splittet mellem Chloe og Abbie fortsætter Sam med at lege med ilden, og det får konsekvenser.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Tenerife Was A 10

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Chicken Shop Date
programme.desc: Slænget er tilbage i Newcastle efter deres tur til Tenerife og mangel på action gør Sofie og Nathan megaliderlige! Sam vil imponere Chloe, men inden længe er der tårer, og det skaber problemer i familien.

programme.title: Torn From The Headlines: New York Post Reports: Million Dollar Murder

programme.title: Pandora's Box: Unleashing Evil: Heat Of The Night

programme.title: Pandora's Box: Unleashing Evil: Bait and Kill

programme.title: Langt fra Bryggen: Episode 104
programme.desc: Stephanie har kastet sig ud i et stort projekt på Sias værelse, men bliver kontaktet af en mand, der påstår at være hendes bror, så Linse kommer forbi. For hvem er egentlig Stephanies biologiske far?

programme.title: Langt fra Bryggen: Episode 105
programme.desc: Stephanie og hendes nyfundne bror, Nicki, står for første gang frem offentligt og fortæller deres historie. Hjemme i huset er der lys for enden af takeaway-tunnelen, for køkkenet ankommer endelig.

programme.title: Langt fra Bryggen: Episode 106
programme.desc: Stephanie kan endelig lave mad sit nye køkken, men hun får noget af et chok, da hun finder ud af præcist, hvor mange penge de har brugt på takeaway. Har de overhovedet råd til at holde housewarming?

programme.title: Langt fra Bryggen: Episode 201
programme.desc: Sidste år renoverede Stephanie og Cengiz drømmehuset, men de er stadig langt fra i mål. De mange dyre projekter presser økonomien hos familien, som måske/måske ikke skal forøges med endnu en baby.

programme.title: Langt fra Bryggen: Episode 202
programme.desc: Cengiz har overtaget nøglerne til sin nye butik, hvor han vil starte en business med at fjerne tatoveringer. Det er en stor investering med meget på spil for både ham og Stephanie.

programme.title: Langt fra Bryggen: Episode 203

programme.title: Langt fra Bryggen: Episode 204

programme.title: Love Island Danmark
programme.desc: Der er overskud af piger, så Camilla og Dina lægger en snedig hemmelig plan få at smidt uønskede elementer ud. Og så kommer der max liv i hideaway, da Liv og Nicolaj får en nat i hinandens selskab.

programme.title: Love Island Danmark
programme.desc: Alberte får en fantastisk overraskelse på sin blind date. Thomas fejrer sin second chance i villaen med også lige at udforske Amalie Maria. Bombshell Aleksandra har blikket rettet mod Jonas.

programme.title: Love Island Danmark
programme.desc: En ny bombshell lander med et brag i villaen. Og Ofelia falder i både Nicolajs og Rayans smag. Liv er rasende. Klods&Kys legen rammer Camilla, da Rayan iskoldt melder sig ind i Ofelia fanklubben.

programme.title: Love Island Danmark
programme.desc: Ofelia er på jagt, men hun holder kortene tæt til kroppen. Liv er ulykkelig over Nicolajs interesse for Ofelia og selv ikke en tur i Hide Away med Alberte stopper Thomas’ flirt med Amalie Maria.

programme.title: Love Island Danmark
programme.desc: Sengekantssnak bliver afsløret og så er der højspændt firkantsdrama mellem Alberte, Aleksandra, Jonas og Thomas. Superfansene får uventet og rystende indflydelse på antallet af beboere i villaen.

programme.title: Love Island Danmark: Episode 216
programme.desc: Sandhedscyklen afslører ubehagelige sandheder om, hvem der er låst og hvem der ikke er. Og på sin klassiske dramasøgende facon, går Alberte all in med spørgsmål. Og en pardannelse medfører stor sorg.

programme.title: Love Island Danmark
programme.desc: En ny bombshells ankomst resulterer i en tårefyldt exit. Og så battler Bombshell’en Ofelia benhårdt Ida for Hide Away’en og dermed en nat med Rayan til Camillas store, tårevædede fortrydelse.

programme.title: Love Island Danmark
programme.desc: Superfansenes observationer skaber ravage i villaen og især Amalie Marias adfærd ryster Kasper dybt. Og så giver Camilla ikke op på sin Rayan og beviser, at alle tricks gælder i krig og kærlighed.

programme.title: Love Island Danmark
programme.desc: Dina og Oliver forsegler deres forhold med en hed badescene, fyrene deler erfaringer om analsex med unge Noah og ligesom der er faldet lidt ro over villaen, fejer Movienight benene væk under beboerne.

programme.title: Love Island Danmark
programme.desc: Afsløringerne sætter ild i villaen! Thomas’ flirt med Amalie Maria og snak bag Albertes ryg skaber højspændt drama mellem Thomas og Alberte, og selv rolige Kasper bliver rasende over afsløringerne.

programme.title: Love Island Danmark
programme.desc: Bølgerne går stadig højt i villaen, for både Alberte og Kasper er fortsat vrede over Thomas og Amalie Marias bedrag. Men Kaspers humør lysner dog gevaldigt ved ankomsten af den nye bombshell Silke.

programme.title: Love Island Danmark
programme.desc: Følelserne kommer i kog under aftenens pardannelse. Jonas skal træffe sit første svære valg. Samtidig blusser romantikken op mellem to tidligere flammer – for gammel kærlighed ruster jo aldrig.

programme.title: Love Island Danmark
programme.desc: Dinas og Olivers forhold testes, da Dina inviteres på date af en mystisk beundrer. Samtidig ser Amalie Maria endelig sandheden i øjnene – kan Thomas rode sig ud af problemerne igen – igen?

programme.title: Love Island Danmark
programme.desc: En fatal pardannelse truer, når to fyre står for fald. Det bliver en afsked med de helt store følelser. Og så lader Rayan sig atter distrahere af sofistikerede Ofelia – til frustration for Camilla.

programme.title: Love Island Danmark
programme.desc: Tøjet ryger, pulsen stiger, og jalousien spirer, når drengene skal strippe. Oliver og Nicolaj rystes af deres partneres reaktioner, og sandheden rammer hårdt, når fremtiden skal måles i procenter.

programme.title: Love Island Danmark
programme.desc: Oliver og Rayan havner i modvind, når fortidens sexeskapader afsløres. Pigerne er i chok! Beboerne står overfor den allersidste pardannelse – uden flere nye singler, og hvor 7 par skal blive til 6.

programme.title: Love Island Danmark
programme.desc: Sandheder kommer på bordet, når løgnedektoren hives frem. Og så nærmer finalen sig med hastige skridt, og markante personligheder må tage afsked, når Superfans igen får indflydelse på sammensætningen.

programme.title: Love Island Danmark
programme.desc: Finaleugen er i gang – og virkeligheden banker ubarmhjertigt på. Babygråd og bleskift bryder idyllen i villaen, og med finalen faretruende tæt på, står parrene over for at træffe en vigtig beslutning.

programme.title: Love Island Danmark
programme.desc: Finalen er lige om hjørnet - to par skal hjem, og nerverne er uden på tøjet – for det er også blevet tid til at møde svigerfamilien. Og midt i det hele popper Oliver det store spørgsmål til Dina.

programme.title: Love Island Danmark
programme.desc: Finaleparrene er fundet! Men hvem vælger I seere som vindere af Love Island 2025? Kan kærligheden bestå sin sidste, ultimative test og sejre?

programme.title: Love Island Danmark
programme.desc: De første kærlighedssøgende beboere ankommer til Love Island villaen, og fem par skal dannes. Hvem spiller spillet, hvem følger hjertet – og hvem bliver valgt fra? Kampen om kærligheden er i gang!

programme.title: Love Island Danmark
programme.desc: Afgørelsen time – hvem vælger hvem i villaens første pardannelse? Og følelser kommer i spil, når en ny pige træder ind i villaen – hvem fristes til at udfordre deres nuværende forbindelse?

programme.title: Love Island Danmark

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 201

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 605

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Familieferie: Old Mike vs. New Mike
programme.desc: Vejen til El Paso slår et uventet sving, da rygter og beskyldninger kommer Mike i hænde. Han sender dem lige til gruppechatten.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Familieferie: El Paso Pt. 2
programme.desc: Festen fortsætter, da DJ Pauly D tackler El Paso og kødbollerne tackler en ugle. Men en Facetime med Angelina knækker Mike.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Second Chances
programme.desc: Wendale kræver svar af hans "Den, der slap væk", Emily. Charlies hoved fordrejes, og stranden leverer en ny kærlighedssyg eks.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Hello New Lad!
programme.desc: Den nye fyr Louis gør et stort indtryk fra starten. Chloe falder for ham, og det bliver Ant ikke glad for. Slænget holder en vild fest.

programme.desc: Ronnie, Ricky og Mike fortæller deres historie. Fra tween popberømmelse i New Edition til at genopstå som Bell Biv DeVoe. Skænderier.

programme.title: Ink Master Redemption: Redemption: X-Rated Blunders
programme.desc: Skæmmet af tatoveringer, der ligner kønsdele, er to lærreder rasende på tatovørerne for at gøre deres tuscher klamme.

programme.title: Ink Master Redemption: Redemption: Lige på og hårdt
programme.desc: Bølgerne går højt, da vrede lærreder er tilbage med overbeskyttende familie. Ty'Esha Reels og Duffy Fortner holder stand på vejen mod forløsning.

programme.title: Ink Master: Lad mig være
programme.desc: Jo mindre tatoveringen er, desto hårdere kan coachenes fald i en mikro-masterdyst blive. I elimineringstatoveringen.

programme.title: Ink Master: Total nedsmeltning
programme.desc: Konkurrencen intensiveres mere end nogensinde, når artisterne testes i komposition med smeltet voks. Kampen om 100.

programme.title: Ink Master: At gøre kunsten efter
programme.desc: Der står mere på spil end nogensinde, når artisterne skal matche coachenes design.

programme.title: Ink Master: Ram plet
programme.desc: Et hold sætter sit præg på en træfarve-lyndyst, der tester kontrast, og en artist må pakke sine maskiner og forlade konkurrencen for altid.

programme.title: Help! I'm in a Secret Relationship!: Kaitlin & Cam
programme.desc: Kaitlin og Cams fling i Vegas fik Kaitlin til at tro, hun har mødt sin prins Charming. Kaitlin kan se en fremtid med Cam, men han holder hende skjult, og det er intet eventyr.

programme.title: Help! I'm in a Secret Relationship!: Lee & Princess
programme.desc: Lee tror, hun har fundet sin drømmepige i Princess. Efter at været flyttet til LA er Lee klar til at indlede deres liv sammen. Men problemet er.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: Harold & Armani
programme.desc: Harold har fundet sin perfekte match, den smukke og sporty Armani. Selvom de bor i det samme kvarter, har de aldrig mødt hinanden.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: Tiana & James
programme.desc: Efter et tre år langt internetforhold, er Tiana flyttet til den til anden side af USA for sin store kærlighed, James.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: Paris & Tara
programme.desc: Paris får hjælp af Nev og Max til at finde ud af, hvem der har catfishet hende de sidste fire år.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: Lucas & Many
programme.desc: Den tidligere Playboy-model Jayme har opdaget, at hendes fyr på nettet ikke bare er falsk, men at han narrer flere kvinder.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: Marvin & Austin
programme.desc: Efter flere måneders med sexting med en flot model, vil Marvin møde ham i virkeligheden.

programme.title: Caught In The Act: Dobbeltliv: Der foregår noget fordækt!
programme.desc: Quinton og halvbroderen Teran mødtes som voksne og fandt straks sammen. Men Terans adfærd blev hurtigt bekymrende.

programme.title: Caught In The Act: Unfaithful: You Gave Up the Cookies!
programme.desc: I næsten tre år har Mariah boet sammen med kæresten, der er faderen til hendes søn. Selv om Bobby elsker hende, har Mariah oplevet noget chokerende.

programme.title: Caught In The Act: Unfaithful: Caught In The Act: Utro
programme.desc: 21-årige Andrew knokler i døgndrift for at stifte familie med kæresten Nikki, men han mistænker, at hun er ham utro med sin yogainstruktør.

programme.title: Just Tattoo Of Us: My Mam And Dad!
programme.desc: Charlottes kæreste Josh kommer med som vært, og hendes far og mor sætter deres ægteskab på prøve.

programme.title: Just Tattoo Of Us: Indecent Proposal
programme.desc: Tatovøren Charl hjælper Charlotte som vært, veninderne Saffron og Sheniya sender hinanden en besked, mor og søn, Mary og Lewis.

programme.title: Storytellers: Storytellers: No Doubt
programme.desc: Sangene inkluderer: "Don't Speak "Ex-Girlfriend" "Just A Girl" "Simple Kind of Life" "Sunday Morning" og "Trapped In A Box".

programme.title: MTV Unplugged: Stone Temple Pilots Unplugged
programme.desc: Den 17.

programme.title: Ink Master: Hjembydysten
programme.desc: 15 internationale tatovører kæmper for at repræsentere deres hjemby, men først skal de erobre en plads i konkurrencen om 250.

programme.title: Revenge Prank with DJ Pauly D & Vinny: The Prank with the Porcupine
programme.desc: Pauly D hjælper Samiah med at hævne sig på hendes mor Chivon ved at invitere hende til at møde hendes "nye kæreste" og hans familie, der er kongelig.

programme.title: Revenge Prank with DJ Pauly D & Vinny: The Prank that Works Out
programme.desc: Vinny hjælper Andrea med at hævne sig på hendes mand, personlig træner Seth.

programme.title: Storytellers: Storytellers: Foo Fighters
programme.desc: Foo Fighters fremfører nogle af deres største hits og deler inspirationen bag hver sang.

programme.desc: Der lægges skumle planer for at få en af de gamle fyre ud til aftenens parceremoni. Dog skal hans partner først lige overtales til at skifte ham ud. Samtidig bilder El Diablo de andre ind, at han har en magt.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel
programme.desc: Der venter gæsterne en fræk overraskelse – det er nemlig erotikuge! Og så går gæsterne ellers i gang med at digte frække rim, prøve hotte kostumer og afprøve sjove sex stillinger.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel: Episode 802
programme.desc: Det er første morgen i paradiset, og solofyren tager på date med de tre mødre. Her serverer han champagne, og gør alt hvad han kan for at overbevise mødrene om, at han fortjener en chance til.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel: Episode 806
programme.desc: Til morgenmaden får pigerne et brev, der bliver afgørende for én af drengenes eksistens på hotellet. De skal nemlig beslutte, hvilken dreng de vil sende hjem.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel: Episode 807
programme.desc: Thomas får mulighed for at charme sig ind på sin partner Nanett, da de skal på en romantisk date. Hjemme på hotellet dukker Rikke op.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel: Episode 808
programme.desc: En af drengene er fredet, og han vælger sig en partner til frokost. Hans valg er meget upopulært hos særligt én pige. Hun bliver sat ud af spillet og derfor ikke må deltage ved parceremonien.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel: Episode 809
programme.desc: Hotellets kvindelige gæster er ikke just henrykte, da hele to nye piger ankommer til Paradiset. Det viser sig dog, at de nye piger skal kæmpe om bare én plads på hotellet ved at speeddate drengene.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel: Episode 810
programme.desc: Hotellets drenge er på en aktiv date sammen med de to nye piger. Imens nyder resten af pigerne deres tid alene på hotellet, hvor særligt en pige deler ud af sine seksuelle hemmeligheder.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel: Episode 811
programme.desc: Hotellets mest ombejlede fyr har et trekantsdrama under opsejling, som han har svært ved at kontrollere. Følelserne får frit løb fra en meget forelsket fyr, men kærligheden ikke er helt gengældt.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel: Episode 814
programme.desc: Mr. Paradise skal kåres, og pigerne får fra morgenstunden til opgave at give hver dreng en kategori til aftenens talentshow. Det vækker ikke ligefrem glæde hos drengene.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel: Episode 815
programme.desc: Mr. Paradise får en vild overraskelse, da han møder sin præmie og nye partner. Imens er to piger på hotellet ved at drive alle til vanvid med en ny sang.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel: Episode 816
programme.desc: Det er torsdag morgen på det smukke hotel. En pige bliver konfronteret med sit dobbeltspil og finder ud af, at hun måske ikke har kunne spille kold og kynisk uden at få følelserne i klemme.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel: Episode 818
programme.desc: Gangsterens første offer får en unik mulighed for at få ram på sin drabsmand. Han kan nemlig sætte en fælde for gangsteren. Om aftenen er der gangsterfest med letpåklædte damer og fyre i jakkesæt.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel: Episode 836
programme.desc: Inden aftenens parceremoni er især hotellets nye pige meget presset. Hun aner ikke, hvem hun kan stole på. For andre af hotellets piger er det kærligheden, der fylder mest.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel: Episode 841
programme.desc: Det nye par på hotellet hygger fra morgenstunden og glæder sig over deres fremtidige partnerskab, mens et andet par dyrker romancen mellem dem.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel: Episode 1806

programme.title: Paradise Hotel: Episode 1817

programme.desc: Gutterne tager til det eksotiske Sommarøy uden for Tromsø for at forvandle en gammel lade til et smukt feriehus. Halvor laver lamper af stråhatte, og Ole og Torkel bruger tømmeret fra den gamle lade på en kreativ måde.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 705
programme.desc: Gutternes næste eventyr fører dem til Halvors hjemegn Nevlunghavn. Her har et ungt par arvet familiens sommerhus, og de ønsker en moderne og mere personlig stil.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 706
programme.desc: Oppe i bjergene med en fantastisk udsigt over Glomfjord finder vi Glomfjord Alpinsenters hytte. Træhytten trænger desperat til lidt kærlighed, så gutterne pakker deres ski og går igang.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 707
programme.desc: I Rennebu ligger der en gård med en gammel bjælkehytte, der ligner et feriehus i Caribien. Fyrene ønsker at finde husets sjæl og må tænke kreativt for at opnå den ultimative kombination af moderne og traditionelt.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 708
programme.desc: Fra stuevinduet ser du lige op mod Gaustatoppen. Gutterne installerer større vinduer, men sørger også for at hytten er hyggelig og tæt på naturen. En overraskelse til faren venter i annekset.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 801
programme.desc: Vi tager en tur til det smukke Orre på Jæren uden for Stavanger. Torkel bygger et smart læskur til blæsende dage, og Ole og Halvor får en sjov idé med at flette terracottafliser ind i trægulvet.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 802
programme.desc: Mændene tager til Ytre Fure på Stadlandet for at lave en gammel schweizervilla om til et idyllisk og praktisk sommerhus. Halvor lærer Ole at tapetsere, og Ole har spændende planer for den gamle lade.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 803
programme.desc: Urke er en lille landsby ved siden af Hjørundfjorden. Her ligger programmets første A-formede hytte. Der skal bl.a. bygges en glasboks med store vinduer til den nye spisestue og laves ovenlysvinduer.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 804
programme.desc: Mændene rejser for første gang til Finnmark, nærmere bestemt Bugøynes. Hytten sammenlignes med "huset på prærien", og ord som "wild west" og "Ralph Lauren" bruges til at beskrive den ønskede stil.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 805
programme.desc: Lige uden for Halden ligger et sted kaldet Aremark, og her giver et ungt par Halvor frie tøjler til at renovere deres skovhytte. Torkel fælder et træ, som bliver lavet om til både bænk, bord og kunst.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 806
programme.desc: Dette års vinterhytte har udsigt over Vågå og er en typisk 80'er fyrretræshytte. Hytten er klar til at blive renoveret, og Halvor viser, hvordan man kan genbruge gamle vinduer og give møbler nyt liv.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 901
programme.desc: Sæsonens første afsnit tager os med til smukke Rott i Tananger. Her er et gammelt "jærhus" ved at blive renoveret. Der bliver bl.a. ændret i grundplanen, og Ole bygger et hyggeligt udhus.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 902
programme.desc: I dette afsnit går turen til det populære sommerhusområde Hvaler, hvor holdet skal forvandle et sjælløst sommerhus til et maritimt paradis.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 903
programme.desc: For enden af et fjeld ved Tjomsland i Larvik kommune ligger et sommerhus, som man næsten ikke kan se. Holdet genbruger mere end normalt, men hytten er stadig helt uigenkendelig, når ugen er omme.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 904
programme.desc: Holdet rejser til Hurum for at renovere et lille sommerhus med mange smalle rum. Der skal åbnes op, og selvfølgelig skal huset have en ny farve. Halvor viser, hvordan man kan genbruge møbler.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 905
programme.desc: Lige uden for Stavanger ligger Randøy, og her finder man et sommerhus med en lidt usædvanlig form. Ejerne bakser med en stor trappe, der tager meget plads, men holdet har en løsning.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 906
programme.desc: Med udsigt over Åsenfjorden ligger en lille sommerhusgrund med 3 huse. Her bor en stor familie, som gerne vil have et pænere udendørs fællesområde samt en renovering af det ældste hus.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 907
programme.desc: Holdet er endelig tilbage på Svalbard. Sommerhuset, som de skal renovere, har udsigt over Adventdalen og Mine 7. Projektet tager en dramatisk drejning, da en isbjørn bliver spottet i området.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 908
programme.desc: Den smukke bjerglandsby Vingelen er klædt på til vinter, og holdet skal renovere et gammelt hus. Ole er som altid kreativ, og Halvor ønsker at modernisere hytten med respekt for den originale stil.

programme.sub-title: One Jeannie Beats Four Of A Kind
programme.desc: Luck for Tony and Roger -- Jeannie proves to be one-of-a-kind.

programme.title: I Dream of Jeannie
programme.desc: Tony's unauthorized chili is "hot" not because of the sauce, but because of his conniving cousin Arvel.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Captain Tony Nelson, an astronaut, is engaged to Melissa Stone, daughter of General Wingard Stone, his commanding officer. Tony is rocketed into space in a capsule which lands is the Pacific. He reaches a small island. There he releases Jeannie, a beautiful blonde, who can perform magic with a blink of her eyes, from a bottle is which she has been imprisoned for ages. Jeannie tells Tony she is his slave forever. Worried about Jeannie's effect on Melissa and his career, Tony tries to leave Jeannie behind on the island, but she smuggles herself aboard the rescue plan. Questioned about his reactions in space by the base psychiatrist, Dr. Alfred Bellows, Tony tells about his meeting with Jeannie. Feeling that Tony is suffering from hallucinations, Bellows calls General Stone.Jeannie appears at Tony's home. Tony tries frantically to keep General Stone, Melissa, Doctor Bellows and Captain Roger Henley, a fellow astronaut, from seeing Jeannie. His problems reach a climax when Jeannie produces a harem of dancing girls to perform for Tony. After Tony works his way out of that, Melissa and her father leave, feeling a vacation, combined with a honeymoon, will solve Tony's problems. Tony orders Jeannie to leave no doubt that she is determined to be a part of Tony's life for a long time.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Jeannie blinks Tony to ancient Persia to defend her honor while Jeannie announces to her parents that this is the man she plans to marry.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.sub-title: Guess What Happened On The Way To The Moon
programme.desc: To test man's ability to survive on the moon, Captain Anthony (Tony) Nelson, and his fellow astronaut, Captain Roger Healey, are ordered to spend a week, in Furnace Canyon, Nevada, 100 degrees in the daytime, 10 below freezing at night. Except for water, they are to live off the land. Jeannie hides in Tony's canteen. Tony tries to make Jeannie understand that she is destroying the value of the mission, but she sticks with him. While Roger barely survives, Tony has every luxury, from food and a harem tent, to a final ride on a camel to finish the journey.Dr. Bellows is baffled to find that while Roger has lost twelve pounds, Tony has gained five. When Tony tries to explain Jeannie's presence, Dr. Bellows concludes that he has the imagina-tion men need to survive on the moon and recommends Tony for a more arduous test, Operation Extinction. Tony tells Jeannie he is taking her with him, but imprisons her within her bottle, de-termined to go on the mission alone.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Although the date hasn't been set, Tony forbids Jeannie from accompanying Melissa and himself on their honeymoon. Grover Caldwell, a young State Department attaché, tells Tony that General Stone, Melissa's father, has accepted an ambassadorial post. General Stone announces he hopes to take Tony, his prospective son-in-law, along as his military aide. When Tony expresses his desire to remain with the space program, Melissa, who has been working to advance the marriage date, tells her father she will change Tony's mind. She suggests that Grover replace Roger as Tony's best man.Jeannie, determined to accompany Tony, prepares an oriental feast when Melissa and her father dine at Tony's. Before serving, Jeannie turns herself into a Filipino houseboy. Melissa suggests they take the houseboy to Europe with them. Tony is given a bachelor dinner in which Jeannie emerges dancing from a prop cake. Jeannie learns that Grover is an old boy friend of Melissa's. Before Jeannie is through, Grover tells Melissa he loves her. Tony is not completely unhappy to be left with Jeannie, when Grover and Melissa declare their intentions to marry.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Jeannie gets jealous on discovering that Tony has a sexy new secretary. Claiming to be a better one, Jeannie insists on joining the WAAFs and taking over the job. Remembering that his friend, Roger Healey, told him that all new WAAFs are being sent overseas, Tony agrees to help Jeannie to join. To her horror, she is sent to San Antonio for basic training. Jeannie has a series of disastrous tryouts in different job categories, in spite of her insistence that she wants an assignment as Captain Nelson's secretary when she becomes a WAAF.When Major Margaret Fiefeld assigns Jeannie as secretary to the commanding officer at the North African base instead, Jeannie folds her arms, blinks, and lands in Tony's office. Tony informs Jeannie that he is being sent to Nevada. Jeannie says she will resign and go with him. Tony then tells her that only troublesome, incompetent girls are discharged and that she cannot resign. Jeannie blinks again, the office is set is turmoil, and Tony resignedly welcomes Jeannie back to civilian life.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: After promising to spend an evening with Jeannie, Tony is tricked by his superiors into conducting aerospace tycoon P.J. Ferguson on a tour of the base. Ferguson's daughter, Nina, de-cides that Tony is her man. P.J. persuades Tony's superior to order Tony to have cocktails aboard his yacht. When Jeannie protests, Tony imprisons her in the vacuum cleaner. Later, after P.J. has Tony assigned to a cruise on his yacht, Mrs. Flaherty, Tony's cleaning woman, accidentally releases Jeannie from the vacuum cleaner. She immediately takes off for the yacht.Jeannie disappears from the yacht during an argument with Tony. Nina and P.J. are certain he has pushed her overboard. Charged with murder, Tony is arrested. Roger Healey, certain Tony has lost his mind, agrees to go to Tony's house and tell the walls and the vacuum cleaner of Tony's plight, Jeannie goes to Tony's cell. Her appearance convinces P.J. that Tony is innocent. Later, searching for privacy, Jeannie and Tony climb into her bottle.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: After telling Tony that he and Roger Healey have been tapped for a historic two-man space probe, scheduled to blast off the following week, Dr. Bellows asks him to report for a final check-up. When Tony asks Jeannie to return to her home, Jeannie asserts that since Tony freed her from the bottle, she belongs to him. She adds that she can give him a space capsule of his own. Tony tells Jeannie if he fails tomorrow's test, he will not go on the flight.Worried about Tony's safety, Jeannie causes him to blurt out the wrong answers to every test. Tony leaves Dr. Bellows, certain he has passed, but Jeannie tells him he has failed. Impressed by Tony's unhappiness, Jeannie goes to Dr. Bellows' office, where he is typing a report on Tony's unfortunate condition. Resorting to all her magic, Jeannie makes Bellows believe that he is not only losing his mind, but is near death. Tony is reassigned to the two-man flight. There, in outer space, Jeannie joins Tony as he floats from a tether attached to the capsule.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Feeling that Jeannie must widen her horizons, Tony gives her a book "How To Be A Woman." Following the book's advice, to share her work with her man, Jeannie neglects her chores and allows the house to go to pot. Reading the chapter on clothing the successful woman, Jeannie charges an expensive wardrobe, in-cluding a mink coat. Convinced by the book that a man should take the woman out to dinner, Jeannie steers Tony to expensive Cafe Scheherazade. She starts a row when she criticizes the authen-ticity of the Arabian dancing.Literally taking the author's advice, Jeannie becomes a career girl and performs miraculous feats of instantaneous cooking while demonstrating electric stoves. Her employer, Sam, feeling she has been planted to get him into trouble with the Better Business Bureau, fires her. Later, after Tony feels he has straightened out things at home, Jeannie hears a news report about the flight of a Russian female astronaut. Blinking her eyes, she is outfitted as an astronaut and insists on accompanying Tony into space.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Tony is assigned as technical director on a new astronaut movie being filmed in Hollywood. Jealous of the star, Rita Mitchell, Jeannie smuggles herself along. All of Jeannie's ruses, including a rainstorm, fail to keep Tony from getting close to Rita. Tony tells Jeannie he is lunching with Rita and jokingly tells Jeannie he would lunch with her instead if she were a star. Determined to become a movie celebrity, Jeannie, seeing a picture of Pola Negri, patterns her personality on the old-time vamp.Although her first try at getting into the movies is viewed as a gag, Jeannie manages to get a screen test with Jason Huberts, which arouses Tony's jealousy. When the test with Jason and Jeannie is shown, only Jason is visible and Jeannie suddenly realizes that genies do not register on film. She is consoled when Tony breaks a date with Rita and they register their footprints in front of Grauman's Chinese with all the movie greats.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Jeannie gets involved with the law when, invisible to everyone, she attempts to drive Tony's car. Angered, Tony orders her to leave. Jeannie is aware that Tony has been studying the desalinization of seawater. Playing for time, she tells Tony her great-grandfather solved the problem. Tony asks to meet her great grandfather and Jeannie goes to get him. Tony phones Leslie Staples at the Department of Agriculture and tells him he is on the verge of converting salt water to fresh. Jeannie returns with her great grandfather, Bilejik, who proves that he can produce fresh water from salt water.When Tony returns to find Bilejik, Jeannie and a policeman are in front of his house. Bilejik has been causing all sorts of trouble with the neighbors. While resolving the matter, Tony discovers that Bilejik used seeds as a filter. After Bilejik leaves, Tony jubilantly reports to Staples. Staples tells him that these seeds are from a plant extinct for almost two thousand years.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: A series of reports by eleven-year-old Custer to his father, Major Ulysses S. Jamison, on the strange feats of magic at Tony's house results in the Major taking his son to Dr. Bellows, the base psychiatrist. Bellows tells Custer he believes his story, and asks him to keep a close watch on Tony. A policeman catches Dr. Bellows and Custer peering into Tony's window and takes them inside for identification. While Bellows is telling Tony that Custer believes he has seen them levitate, Jeannie causes him to do so. Bellows bows out, feeling he has stumbled on a top-secret aerospace project.Tony voices his nervousness to Jeannie about being spied on by Custer. When Custer disappears, Tony accuses Jeannie of turning him into nothing. Angered, Jeannie leaves. Later, when Custer comes back, having spent the day at a carnival, Tony penitently begins searching for Jeannie. He is sure Jeannie has joined a carnival act and starts a riot at the sideshow when he mistakes a veiled woman for Jeannie. Jeannie returns home and starts pulling down all the shades to outwit Custer.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Jeannie is annoyed when Diane Rodney, a friend of Tony's, returns to town, determined to resume their old relationship. As a result, when Jeannie runs into Roger, while driving Tony's car, she accepts his invitation to dinner. Unaware that Jeannie is Roger's date, Tony instructs his friend in the fine art of courtship. Later, when Jeannie tells him she doesn't know her date's name, Tony begins to worry. When Diane arrives, Tony drags her all over town searching for Jeannie. The two couples finally meet at a nightclub. Alone with Jeannie, Tony demands she return home. Jeannie tells him she is going to listen to Roger's records.At Roger's apartment, Jeannie wards off all his attempts at romance. She leaves shortly before Tony pounds on the door looking for her. Tony points out to Roger all the mistakes he would be making if he married her. Convinced, Roger admits Tony has saved him from making a fool of himself. Jeannie is overjoyed by Tony's concern for her. Tony replies that, after all, he is only human.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Jeannie agrees not to date Roger if Tony doesn't go out with other girls. Then Tony and Roger are assigned to escort Russian cosmonauts Major Tiomkin and Major Posnovsky during a goodwill visit. Major Tiomkin proves to be a beautiful girl named Sonya, who immediately stakes a claim on Tony. Angered, Jeannie tells Tony she is going out with Roger. Tony imprisons Jeannie in her bottle. Jeannie maneuvers the bottle into the pocket of Roger's raincoat. Roger presents the bottle to Sonya. Tony gets involved in a fracas with General Barkley and Dr. Bellows in his unsuccessful try to get the bottle back. When Sonya opens the bottle, Jeannie appears. Pointing to Sonya as her new mistress, she tells the cosmonaut she can make her every wish come true.When the plane on which Sonya is scheduled to return leaves, Tony feels her country now has possession of a decisive secret weapon. Later, dripping furs and jewelry, Sonya comes to Tony's home. She tells him Jeannie has granted her fondest desire by turning her into a wealthy American. programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Unable to persuade Tony to marry her, Jeannie decides she needs a mother's counsel. She blinks her eyes and Mama appears. Mama assures Jeannie Tony will change his mind if he thinks Jeannie is going to marry Roger. Tony asks Roger if he has met Jeannie's parents. Then Dr. Bellows announces he has bought the lot across the street. Roger asks to meet Jeannie's parents. She produces a house on Dr. Bellows' lot. Tony sees Dr. Bellows and General Hadley approaching the lot. Responding to Tony's pleas, Jeannie makes the house vanish. General Hadley and Dr. Bellows see Tony sitting in the weeds sipping tea. Making the house reappear, Jeannie produces parents for Roger's visit.Tony comes to the house and forbids Jeannie to marry Roger. Then Dr. Bellows drives up. Seeing the house, he becomes distraught, and runs to Tony. As the house disappears again, they see Roger sitting in the weeds. The following day, Roger tells Tony he found himself wandering around a vacant lot. When he returned to apologize, Jeannie and the house were gone. Smiling at Jeannie, hiding in his desk drawer, Tony assures Roger he Will let him know if he ever meets Jeannie again.

programme.desc: To test man's ability to survive on the moon, Captain Anthony (Tony) Nelson, and his fellow astronaut, Captain Roger Healey, are ordered to spend a week, in Furnace Canyon, Nevada, 100 degrees in the daytime, 10 below freezing at night. Except for water, they are to live off the land. Jeannie hides in Tony's canteen. Tony tries to make Jeannie understand that she is destroying the value of the mission, but she sticks with him. programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Although the date hasn't been set, Tony forbids Jeannie from accompanying Melissa and himself on their honeymoon. Grover Caldwell, a young State Department attaché, tells Tony that General Stone, Melissa's father, has accepted an ambassadorial post. General Stone announces he hopes to take Tony, his prospective son-in-law, along as his military aide. When Tony expresses his desire to remain with the space program, Melissa, who has been working to advance the marriage date, tells her father she will change Tony's mind. She suggests that Grover replace Roger as Tony's best man.Jeannie, determined to accompany Tony, prepares an oriental feast when Melissa and her father dine at Tony's. Before serving, Jeannie turns herself into a Filipino houseboy. Melissa suggests they take the houseboy to Europe with them. Tony is given a bachelor dinner in which Jeannie emerges dancing from a prop cake. Jeannie learns that Grover is an old boy friend of Melissa's. Before Jeannie is through, Grover tells Melissa he loves her. Tony is not completely unhappy to be left with Jeannie, when Grover and Melissa declare their intentions to marry.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Jeannie gets jealous on discovering that Tony has a sexy new secretary. Claiming to be a better one, Jeannie insists on joining the WAAFs and taking over the job. Remembering that his friend, Roger Healey, told him that all new WAAFs are being sent overseas, Tony agrees to help Jeannie to join. To her horror, she is sent to San Antonio for basic training. Jeannie has a series of disastrous tryouts in different job categories, in spite of her insistence that she wants an assignment as Captain Nelson's secretary when she becomes a WAAF.When Major Margaret Fiefeld assigns Jeannie as secretary to the commanding officer at the North African base instead, Jeannie folds her arms, blinks, and lands in Tony's office. Tony informs Jeannie that he is being sent to Nevada. Jeannie says she will resign and go with him. Tony then tells her that only troublesome, incompetent girls are discharged and that she cannot resign. Jeannie blinks again, the office is set is turmoil, and Tony resignedly welcomes Jeannie back to civilian life.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: After promising to spend an evening with Jeannie, Tony is tricked by his superiors into conducting aerospace tycoon P.J. Ferguson on a tour of the base. Ferguson's daughter, Nina, de-cides that Tony is her man. P.J. persuades Tony's superior to order Tony to have cocktails aboard his yacht. When Jeannie protests, Tony imprisons her in the vacuum cleaner. Later, after P.J. has Tony assigned to a cruise on his yacht, Mrs. Flaherty, Tony's cleaning woman, accidentally releases Jeannie from the vacuum cleaner. She immediately takes off for the yacht.Jeannie disappears from the yacht during an argument with Tony. Nina and P.J. are certain he has pushed her overboard. Charged with murder, Tony is arrested. Roger Healey, certain Tony has lost his mind, agrees to go to Tony's house and tell the walls and the vacuum cleaner of Tony's plight, Jeannie goes to Tony's cell. Her appearance convinces P.J. that Tony is innocent. Later, searching for privacy, Jeannie and Tony climb into her bottle.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: After telling Tony that he and Roger Healey have been tapped for a historic two-man space probe, scheduled to blast off the following week, Dr. Bellows asks him to report for a final check-up. When Tony asks Jeannie to return to her home, Jeannie asserts that since Tony freed her from the bottle, she belongs to him. She adds that she can give him a space capsule of his own. Tony tells Jeannie if he fails tomorrow's test, he will not go on the flight.Worried about Tony's safety, Jeannie causes him to blurt out the wrong answers to every test. Tony leaves Dr. Bellows, certain he has passed, but Jeannie tells him he has failed. Impressed by Tony's unhappiness, Jeannie goes to Dr. Bellows' office, where he is typing a report on Tony's unfortunate condition. Resorting to all her magic, Jeannie makes Bellows believe that he is not only losing his mind, but is near death. Tony is reassigned to the two-man flight. There, in outer space, Jeannie joins Tony as he floats from a tether attached to the capsule.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Feeling that Jeannie must widen her horizons, Tony gives her a book "How To Be A Woman." Following the book's advice, to share her work with her man, Jeannie neglects her chores and allows the house to go to pot. Reading the chapter on clothing the successful woman, Jeannie charges an expensive wardrobe, in-cluding a mink coat. Convinced by the book that a man should take the woman out to dinner, Jeannie steers Tony to expensive Cafe Scheherazade. She starts a row when she criticizes the authen-ticity of the Arabian dancing.Literally taking the author's advice, Jeannie becomes a career girl and performs miraculous feats of instantaneous cooking while demonstrating electric stoves. Her employer, Sam, feeling she has been planted to get him into trouble with the Better Business Bureau, fires her. Later, after Tony feels he has straightened out things at home, Jeannie hears a news report about the flight of a Russian female astronaut. Blinking her eyes, she is outfitted as an astronaut and insists on accompanying Tony into space.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Tony is assigned as technical director on a new astronaut movie being filmed in Hollywood. Jealous of the star, Rita Mitchell, Jeannie smuggles herself along. All of Jeannie's ruses, including a rainstorm, fail to keep Tony from getting close to Rita. Tony tells Jeannie he is lunching with Rita and jokingly tells Jeannie he would lunch with her instead if she were a star. Determined to become a movie celebrity, Jeannie, seeing a picture of Pola Negri, patterns her personality on the old-time vamp.Although her first try at getting into the movies is viewed as a gag, Jeannie manages to get a screen test with Jason Huberts, which arouses Tony's jealousy. When the test with Jason and Jeannie is shown, only Jason is visible and Jeannie suddenly realizes that genies do not register on film. She is consoled when Tony breaks a date with Rita and they register their footprints in front of Grauman's Chinese with all the movie greats.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Jeannie gets involved with the law when, invisible to everyone, she attempts to drive Tony's car. Angered, Tony orders her to leave. Jeannie is aware that Tony has been studying the desalinization of seawater. Playing for time, she tells Tony her great-grandfather solved the problem. Tony asks to meet her great grandfather and Jeannie goes to get him. Tony phones Leslie Staples at the Department of Agriculture and tells him he is on the verge of converting salt water to fresh. Jeannie returns with her great grandfather, Bilejik, who proves that he can produce fresh water from salt water.When Tony returns to find Bilejik, Jeannie and a policeman are in front of his house. Bilejik has been causing all sorts of trouble with the neighbors. While resolving the matter, Tony discovers that Bilejik used seeds as a filter. After Bilejik leaves, Tony jubilantly reports to Staples. Staples tells him that these seeds are from a plant extinct for almost two thousand years.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: A series of reports by eleven-year-old Custer to his father, Major Ulysses S. Jamison, on the strange feats of magic at Tony's house results in the Major taking his son to Dr. Bellows, the base psychiatrist. Bellows tells Custer he believes his story, and asks him to keep a close watch on Tony. A policeman catches Dr. Bellows and Custer peering into Tony's window and takes them inside for identification. While Bellows is telling Tony that Custer believes he has seen them levitate, Jeannie causes him to do so. Bellows bows out, feeling he has stumbled on a top-secret aerospace project.Tony voices his nervousness to Jeannie about being spied on by Custer. When Custer disappears, Tony accuses Jeannie of turning him into nothing. Angered, Jeannie leaves. Later, when Custer comes back, having spent the day at a carnival, Tony penitently begins searching for Jeannie. He is sure Jeannie has joined a carnival act and starts a riot at the sideshow when he mistakes a veiled woman for Jeannie. Jeannie returns home and starts pulling down all the shades to outwit Custer.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Jeannie is annoyed when Diane Rodney, a friend of Tony's, returns to town, determined to resume their old relationship. As a result, when Jeannie runs into Roger, while driving Tony's car, she accepts his invitation to dinner. Unaware that Jeannie is Roger's date, Tony instructs his friend in the fine art of courtship. Later, when Jeannie tells him she doesn't know her date's name, Tony begins to worry. When Diane arrives, Tony drags her all over town searching for Jeannie. The two couples finally meet at a nightclub. Alone with Jeannie, Tony demands she return home. Jeannie tells him she is going to listen to Roger's records.At Roger's apartment, Jeannie wards off all his attempts at romance. She leaves shortly before Tony pounds on the door looking for her. Tony points out to Roger all the mistakes he would be making if he married her. Convinced, Roger admits Tony has saved him from making a fool of himself. Jeannie is overjoyed by Tony's concern for her. Tony replies that, after all, he is only human.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Trysil
programme.desc: The mountains and snowfall in Trysil mean that the town has to be creative with food; Tareq learns how to make cheese in the traditional way, and goes skiing of course, and takes to the slopes to cook something as skiers pass by.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Värmland
programme.desc: Värmland is home to many of Sweden’s most famous authors and inventors. However, it is also a place with a rich food culture. Tareq gets his hands on a very rare bird to cook and also takes time out to float down a tranquil river on a wooden raft.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Fyn
programme.desc: Tareq visits Fyn, the fairy tale capital of the world. Famous as the birthplace of Hans Christian Andersen, Fyn is also known as the garden of Denmark. Here we explore stunning nature and world class cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Höga Kusten
programme.desc: Created thousands of years ago, the High Coast in the northern part of Sweden is the highest coast in the world. Tareq sets out to sample one of the most extreme types of Swedish food, fermented herring.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Denmark
programme.desc: North Jutland has a rich culinary history. The unique conditions have created equally unique products. Tareq meets local food entrepreneurs who have learned to adapt to this ever changing environment and putting this region on the culinary map.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Uppsala
programme.desc: Uppsala is the city of knowledge: home to the oldest university in Scandinavia. It’s a wonderful agricultural area surrounded by fertile flatlands. Tareq discovers the historical treasures of Uppsala and its thriving culinary life.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Sealand
programme.desc: North Zealand has been a playground of the rich and famous since the fifteenth century. Tareq learns how this beautiful north eastern part of Denmark is the perfect place to go foraging for wild berries and herbs.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åre
programme.desc: Sweden’s largest ski resort Åre is well known for its local ingredients, boasting the highest number of organic food producers per capita in Sweden. The fresh water and clean air create unique conditions for growing excellent food.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: The Danish Lakelands
programme.desc: The Danish Lakelands produce some of the finest ingredients that you can find. Tareq has a go at an old cooking technique from New Zealand called Hangi - using heated rocks buried in a pit oven.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: West Sweden
programme.desc: Gothenburg on the west coast of Sweden has recently been discovered as an exciting destination by both international travel journalists and food bloggers. Tareq tracks down an old army barracks which has been converted into a world class cheese factory.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Luleå
programme.desc: Tareq visits Luleå, home to the beautiful Tree Hotel: a collection of treehouses built by an award winning architect. Following the river further up into the mountains he reaches the land where, for centuries, the Sami people kept their reindeer herds.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Halmstad
programme.desc: In Halmstad Tareq explores the contrast between the busy summer scene at the beach and the quiet rural country life, meeting Jörgen Persson: award winning table tennis player and visiting a village famous for its cheese.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kemi
programme.desc: Kemi is situated in northern Finland by the Bothnian Bay and it is part of Lapland region. Tareq tries his luck at a spot of burbot fishing on the frozen sea and visits the snow castle hotel.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: West Sweden
programme.desc: Situated on the west coast of Sweden, Bohuslän is a place where you can really feel the history of fishing all around a tradition that is still active. Tareq will be harvesting supreme quality oysters and lobsters and cook some wonderful seafood dishes.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Florø
programme.desc: Tareq visits Norway and Florø to celebrate their national day -17th of May. Surrounded by breathtaking archipelagos and stunning fjords he dives for scallops in the north sea, cooking at mountain peaks and exploring the history of norwegian salmon

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Estonia
programme.desc: Tareq makes his way across the baltic sea to Estonia and the capital Tallinn. He discovers the historical treasures of the city and its thriving culinary life before he heads out into the vast and beautiful countryside and the national park of Soomaa.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Ringkøbing
programme.desc: Ringkøbing, a lovely old market town located at the west coast of Denmark. Here, Tareq visit a traditional Herring Festival and meets up with local entrepreneurs who have learned to adapt to this ever-changing environment.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Falkenberg
programme.desc: Something is definitely happening in Falkenberg on the west coast of Sweden. Over the last couple of years it have become somewhat of a haven for foodies. Tareq is on a mission; taking him through a fertile landscape with vineyards and salmon fishing.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Estonia (Part 2)
programme.desc: Estonia has embarked on a journey greatly inspired by the nordic cuisine. Tareq explores the countryside of Estonia before he returns to the capital of Tallinn where he meets people that really love their traditional food.

programme.desc: Tareq bikes through the unique landscape of Öland, Sweden's second largest island located in the Baltic Sea. It is a place where the interaction between man and nature have created a diverse and rich farmland with an amazing amount of small producers.

programme.desc: Bornholm, the sunny bright green island with it’s own gastronomic tone is a true pioneer when it comes to local food at it’s finest quality. Tareq visit Denmark's first regional food culture house where they develop this unique flourishing cuisine.

programme.title: The New Detectives: In the Camera's Eye
programme.desc: Photography has long been a vital tool in homicide investigations. A single image captures enough information to identify a suspect, and to preserve a vital clue long after a witness' memory fades.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Wasted Youth
programme.desc: When teenagers are driven to kill, their victims are but the first to fall. In three such cases, the families of the killers, as well as their communities, become the victims of violent crime.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Collective Justice
programme.desc: Philadelphia's Vidocq Society, named after an 18th Century French detective, is one of the world's most unusual crime-solving organizations.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Murder For Hire
programme.desc: For some killers, murder can be a profitable business. And the scene of the crime can be both a source for clues, and puzzling questions. When a victim has been targeted for death, investigators must look beyond the obvious to uncover a murder for hire.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Toxic Death
programme.desc: Sometimes, the cause of death does not match the scene of the crime. When an untraceable poison is used to commit murder, homicide detectives turn to forensic toxicologists to follow a killer's tracks and expose a toxic death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Material Witness
programme.desc: Lies and deceit can often throw investigators off the trail of justice. But when hard evidence contradicts a killer's story, police must use the clues to piece together the truth.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Betrayed
programme.desc: Sometimes when a death seems to be accidental or the result of a tragic accident, it is up to forensic scientists to reveal the deception lying just below the surface.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Elements Of Murder
programme.desc: There are several things that can suggest murder; jealousy, anger, poison. When everyday substances reveal hidden clues that break a homicide case, those substances become the elements of murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Random Targets
programme.desc: Most victims of multiple murderers are meticulously chosen because of a mutual connection with the killer or because they match an intricate set of criteria that fits the killer's MO.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Grave Secrets
programme.desc: Killers often attempt to deflect attention away from their crimes by hiding the remains of their victims. Bodies may lay hidden for years before they are discovered.

programme.title: The New Detectives: At Close Range
programme.desc: When a victim is gunned down at point-blank range, police often assume that a friend or acquaintance is to blame.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lethal Encounter
programme.desc: In most homicides, police rely on motive to pursue a murderer. But when the killer is a stranger the crime may go unsolved for years. It takes a full arsenal of forensic techniques to trace a lethal encounter.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Crimes Of Passion
programme.desc: When killers are driven by jealousy and desire, their desperation is evident in both the crime and their efforts to avoid detection. But forensic science can reveal even the slightest mistake to solve crimes of passion.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Absent Witness
programme.desc: When killers hide or destroy the remains of their victims, it becomes the mission of forensic scientists to reconstruct the scenes and prove murder for an absent witness.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Marked For Death
programme.desc: Sometimes killers are careful to leave no fingerprints behind. But methods of the murder itself can leave a lasting impression on police, especially when the tools (or weapons) of a killer's trade leave an innocent victim marked for death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Abduction
programme.desc: Anytime, anywhere, people disappear, kidnapped from their daily routines. Predators always leave clues behind, but chasing them takes time, hampering investigators' attempts to solve these fatal abductions.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Medical Examiners's Casebook
programme.desc: Some killers choose to hide their victims. And investigators must then rely on forensic examiners to uncover proof of murder. These are just two extraordinary crimes that have made their way into the medical examiner's casebook.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trial By Fire
programme.desc: At a crime scene, anything left behind or seemingly out of place is considered a clue. But a fire can extinguish everything in its path challenging forensic investigators at every turn and making each arson a trial by fire.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Undaunted
programme.desc: Solving crimes may begin with gut intuition, but advanced science provides investigators with irrefutable proof. When criminals go to great lengths to mask their crimes, investigators must step up the challenge and remain forever undaunted.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1304
programme.desc: Der er ikke mange ting tilbage på realitystjernen Vivi Bachs krop, der ikke har været forbi en kirurg , men kan Paradise-baben mon diske op med en menu med lige så meget kirurgisk præcision?

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1305
programme.desc: En forsamling af fire vidt forskellige personligheder mødes, når designeren Søren Le Schmidt skal imponere, men ikke alle ved bordet er lige diplomatiske, når de tilkendegiver deres holdninger.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1306
programme.desc: Det bliver en på mange måder grænseoverskridende aften, når filmproducenten Peter Aalbæk Jensen inviterer sine gæster til middag. En aften fyldt med overraskelser og uenigheder, de sent glemmer.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1307
programme.desc: Det er en højlydt oplevelse på alle måder, når aftenens vært, journalist og podcastvært Ditte Okman, byder indenfor, men det er ikke alle, der lader sig imponere af ekstravagant pynt og dyre råvarer.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1308
programme.desc: Det er ikke alt, der går helt som det skal, når hardliner politikeren, Mette Thiesen inviterer sine gæster på en overraskende menu. Heldigvis kan meget reddes med lidt vand.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1309
programme.desc: Flere af gæsterne føler sig hjemme, når influencer Nynne Larsen inviterer til middag i Værebroparken. På trods af den lille lejlighed, er der plads til dybe spørgsmål.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1310
programme.desc: Sanger og radiovært Nadia Malm inviterer indenfor. Spørgsmålene er mange, for hvordan er det at dele navn med én, der blev lagt for had landet over, da dokumentaren, Den Sorte Svane, kom frem.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1311
programme.desc: Det går sjældent kedeligt for sig i selskab med realitystjerne, model og influencer Sinan Türkmen, og det gør det heller ikke, når han inviterer til middag i sit hjem på Østerbro i København.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1312
programme.desc: Selvom man bor småt, kan man godt invitere til middagsselskab. Det beviser radio- og tv-vært Helin Erdem, når hun inviterer sine gæster med til sit elskede Albertslund.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1313
programme.desc: Pizzakokken Gorm Wisweh inviterer til middag i sommerhuset ved Jægerspris. Men hvis gæsterne vil have noget at spise, må de selv hjælpe til. Tilgengæld lukker Gorm op for personlige historier.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1314
programme.desc: Realitystjernen Sille Nimholm inviterer indenfor i sit hjem i Albertslund, men ikke alle er imponeret over smagen. Værten åbner til gengæld op omkring retssager, og hvordan hun holder humøret oppe.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1315
programme.desc: TV-kendissen Linse Kessler byder på middag på sin elskede Bryggen, Islands Brygge i København. Her er plads til latter og sang, men med Linses nuværende økonomi er der ikke plads til meget mere.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1316
programme.desc: Politikeren Sikandar Siddique byder sine gæster indenfor til en oplevelse, der giver gæsterne et indblik i sin baggrund, og vi er med når Sikandar åbner op om en yderst svær periode i sit liv.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1301
programme.desc: Realitystjernen Gustav Salinas byder indenfor i sin eksklusive lejlighed. Værten byder på mad fra varme lande, og lukker sine farvestrålende gæster indenfor i sit svære kærlighedsliv.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1302
programme.desc: Jackie Navarro er en af Danmarks største tv-personligheder og influencere, og i aften byder hun indenfor i sin villa nord for København. Snakken går, når Jackie åbner op om både kærlighed og had.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1303
programme.desc: Der bliver budt på en rørende aften, når kendisfrisør Dennis Knudsen byder indenfor i sin luksusvilla i Korsør. Han lover mad på max 20 minutter - men mon det virkelig kan lade sig gøre uden hjælp?
